description: Pepe confirms hidden movement through the alley.

nodes.speaker: pepe
nodes.text: You do not walk into this alley unless you are lost, stupid, or looking for the route behind the route.

options.text: Then give me the route behind the route.

nodes.speaker: pepe
nodes.text: Somebody moved a scared passenger through here under protection. Fast feet, controlled stops, no room for witnesses. That is transport, not panic.
